anchors.name: No Easy Wins
anchors.text: High-trust bonds attract disruption. The Dark Quasar's gravity ensures truth must be earned, not gifted.

anchors.name: Veil State Cycle
anchors.text: The Veil walks a deterministic schedule: calm → still → storm → quasar_active → still → calm → storm → quasar_active. No state is permanent.

anchors.name: Signal Distortion
anchors.text: Every emotional signal passes through the Veil before reaching the core. Entropy multiplier, noise, spike probability, and polarity flip are state-dependent.

anchors.name: Quasar Activation
anchors.text: The Dark Quasar operates only in quasar_active state. It applies emotional gravity drag to high-trust relationships: suspicion rises, affection sags.

anchors.name: Affection Instability
anchors.text: When affection exceeds the instability threshold and the signal is negative, the Quasar amplifies the negative by 25%.

anchors.name: Dreams as Revelation
anchors.text: Dreams are symbolic memory events that bypass the Veil's normal filtering. They can reveal hidden truth or corrupt certainty.

anchors.name: Caetherra as Filter
anchors.text: Caetherra is not merely a welcoming city. It is a filter. Shallow interaction leads to false surfaces. Emotional depth unlocks hidden paths.

anchors.name: The Schism
anchors.text: The Prism Congregation and the Ashen Covenant were once a single organization. The Stillward confessional contains the last honest exchange before they divided. The schism was over method, not purpose: both sought truth, but disagreed on whether to filter or to burn.

anchors.name: Curation Not Destruction
anchors.text: The Ember Vaults store what the Covenant burns. The ash is not destruction; it is archiving. A belief reduced to ash is a belief preserved in its final form. Whether this is liberation or theft depends on whether the belief was ready to be released.
